findings.description: [AI-SAST via Code Scan Verification Validation | claude-opus-5] Settings.DATABASE_URL assembles the connection with sqlalchemy URL.create, passing username, password, host, port, database and query parameters as separate components rather than interpolating a string, so a ';', '@' or '?host=' inside a credential stays inside that value and cannot append or relocate a connection parameter | verdict=pass confidence=high

[AI-SAST via Code Scan Verification Validation | claude-opus-5] No hardcoded or user-influenced connection string exists: every component is required from the environment or secret store with no default, no request-derived value reaches the property, and POSTGRES_SSLMODE is validated against an allow-list that refuses any plaintext-capable mode | verdict=pass confidence=high

[AI-SAST via Code Scan Verification Validation | claude-opus-5] The URL object is handed to create_engine without being stringified, which keeps the password out of anything that logs the URL | verdict=pass confidence=high
